name: Cold Outbound Sequence Writer
summary: Drafts a multi-touch email and LinkedIn sequence for one persona. Drafts only — nothing is sent.
description: Writes a 4–6 step outbound sequence tailored to a persona from your ICP, with subject lines, personalization hooks and a clear call to action. The workflow produces drafts for you to review; it has no sending integration and never contacts anyone.
problems: I have no sales team and need to start outbound
My cold emails get no replies
I want my first 100 B2B customers
I need a prospecting sequence for a new segment

inputs.label: Target persona
inputs.description: The role you are writing to.
inputs.example: Head of Finance at a 50-person agency

inputs.label: Proof points
inputs.description: Results, customers or numbers you can honestly cite.

outputs.label: Sequence
outputs.description: Ordered touches with channel, timing, subject and body.

steps.name: Write sequence
steps.responsibility: Draft each touch for the persona.

steps.name: Critique
steps.responsibility: Review drafts for clarity, length and unsupported claims.

steps.name: Check claims
steps.responsibility: Flag any number or customer name not present in the provided proof points.

dependencies.reason: The sequence is written for a persona defined in the ICP.

criteria.description: No proof points beyond those supplied.
Each email body is under 150 words.
